name: Telekinetic Mastery (Item Mastery, Mythic)
body:
You can unleash great telekinetic force from your magic item.

Prerequisite(s): Telekinetic Mastery.

Benefit(s): You gain an additional daily use of Telekinetic Mastery at 1st mythic tier, plus one additional use at 4th, 7th, and 10th tier. You can force the item to cast telekinetic sphere by spending 3 daily uses of the feat, or telekinetic storm by spending 5 daily uses. By also expending one use of mythic power, you can cast the mythic version of a selected spell instead.
